[{"id": "nnvMTG5Sl5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83e\udec2Ministries Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B-CtTCmVDX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The ministries module contains features related to functions and specific ministries of the church.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w8oEjl0tNc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\uddd3\ufe0fFunctions", "col": 12}}, {"id": "riOh9J0you", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Church functions are used to track attendance and for linking to other documents.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "6k3AeERCdQ", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When creating a function, note the following:
- Default function types are provided, but additional function types can be created.
    - When creating a function type, you can choose an existing function as a 'template function'. This will allow you to click the 'Fill From Template' button when creating this type of function in the future to fill in most of the function details using the template function's values.
- Other documents can be linked as items in the function's schedule (i.e. Songs, Sermons, People, Bible References, etc)
- Attendance can be tracked (Additional attendance types can be added if needed)
    - To pre-populate attendance for a function, you can select a 'template function' in the related function type. Then clicking the 'Fill From Template' button will pre-populate all attendance records from the template function.
- To publish a function to the public website, check the 'Publish' checkbox.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "_0iXv3IWcn", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Ministries workspace includes links to function and attendance reports.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "TvoZni0RtF", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Hint: in the Function list view, change the view type to 'Calendar' to view the Functions on a calendar.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "recur-h2-001", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udd01Recurring Functions", "col": 12}}, {"id": "recur-desc-01", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "A function can recreate itself automatically on a schedule (e.g. a weekly Bible Study). Once an occurrence's end date/time passes, the next one is created with the same schedule, attendance roster, associations, and other template details.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "recur-desc-02", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "To enable recurrence on a Function:
- Expand the Recurrence section and check Automatically Recreate.
- Choose a Repeat Frequency (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Yearly), and (where applicable) the day of week or day of month.
- Optionally set a Repeat Until date to stop creating new occurrences after that date.
- Uncheck Automatically Recreate at any time to stop generating new occurrences.
Tip: open a Ministry and click Create Recurring Function to start a new recurring function pre-linked to that ministry. Each ministry's Recurring Functions list shows all of the recurring functions associated with the ministry.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fsu-h2-001", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udcddFunction Sign-Ups", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fsu-desc-01", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Function sign-ups allow people to indicate their intent to attend a function and optionally bring/complete specific items.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fsu-desc-02", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When creating a sign-up, note the following:
- Only Functions that have Allow Sign-Ups enabled will be available in the 'Function' field.
- Each person can only have one sign-up per function.
- The Attending checkbox indicates whether the person plans to attend.
    - Checking this will automatically add an attendance record to the Function with a status of: 'Signed-Up'
    - Unchecking this will remove any attendance record for the Person from the Function
- If the Function has sign-up items defined, you can add rows to indicate which (and how many of those) items you will bring/complete.
    - The Signed Up quantity on each item in the Function document will automatically update to reflect the total quantity indicated in sign-ups.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fsu-h3-001", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\udce6Sign-Up Items", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fsu-item-01", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Sign-up items represent things that are needed for a function (e.g. food, supplies, jobs, etc). They are added to a function's Sign-Up Items table with the quantity needed. As people submit sign-ups and indicate they will bring specific items, the Quantity Signed Up on the function is automatically totaled across all sign-ups and displayed on the Function document.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fci-h2-001", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\u2705Function Check-Ins", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fci-desc-01", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Function check-ins are a record that a person has physically arrived at a function.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "fci-desc-02", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When creating a check-in, note the following:
- Each person can only be checked in once per function.
- Upon saving, the person's attendance record on the function will automatically be set to Checked-In.
- Deleting a check-in will remove the associated Checked-In attendance record from the function.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "KbmdGnFK8k", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Bulk Check-In
1. Open the Person list view.
2. Select (Check) the people you would like to check-in.
3. Click `Actions -> Check In`
4. Choose which Function for which you would like to check the people in.
The people's attendance will be tracked in the Function document.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "bLMhfdXsV3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83c\udfb5Songs", "col": 12}}, {"id": "7ts41_VmsH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Songs can be added as items to a church function.
Note: there is not currently a way to present a song. This is planned in future versions.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "ljVNwCikn3", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When creating a song, note the following:
- If you know the CCLI number for the song, you can add it. This may be used in future enhancements.
- You can add any number of slides to a song.
- After creating a song, you may want to add it to a function's schedule.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "cc_h", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\uddc2\ufe0fCounseling Cases", "col": 12}}, {"id": "cc_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Counseling Cases are confidential case files (restricted to Church Manager).
- Record the person, counselor, summary, and status.
- Each meeting is logged as a row in the 'Sessions' table.
- New Case Types can be added as needed.", "col": 12}}]
